description: Phase 5 Wave 1 — Plan 01: Prisma schema migration (agentType on Message, AppSettings model) and update Trend Mapper route handler to filter/persist by agentType. Database foundation for multi-agent isolation. Base branch: ralph/phase-4-ui-polish.

userStories.title: Prisma schema migration — agentType on Message + AppSettings model
userStories.description: As the system, I need a database schema that isolates messages per agent and tracks a global session number, so that switching between agents in the UI never shows the wrong chat history.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `prisma/schema.prisma` — add `agentType  String  @default("trend-mapper")` to the Message model AFTER the projectId field
Add composite index `@@index([projectId, agentType, createdAt])` to Message model (keep existing `@@index([projectId, createdAt])` too)
Add new model at bottom of schema.prisma: `model AppSettings { id Int @id @default(1); sessionNumber Int @default(1) }`
Run migration: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_agent_type_and_app_settings`
Create `scripts/seed-settings.ts` that does `prisma.appSettings.upsert({ where: { id: 1 }, create: { id: 1, sessionNumber: 1 }, update: {} })` then logs 'AppSettings seeded'
userStories.notes: Read prisma/schema.prisma and prisma.config.ts first. IMPORTANT: Prisma client is imported from '@/generated/prisma/client' (NOT '@prisma/client') — check src/lib/prisma.ts for the exact import. The seed script must import prisma from '../src/lib/prisma'. Safe migration: SQLite ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT is non-destructive — all existing Trend Mapper messages will get agentType='trend-mapper' automatically.

userStories.title: Update Trend Mapper route handler to filter and persist by agentType
userStories.description: As the system, I need the existing chat route handler to accept agentType from the POST body and use it in all DB operations, so that each agent's messages are isolated from the others.
acceptanceCriteria: In `src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts`, destructure `agentType` from request body with default 'trend-mapper': `const { messages: incomingMessages, agentType = 'trend-mapper' } = await request.json()`
Update the `prisma.message.findMany` WHERE clause to include agentType: `where: { projectId, agentType }`
Update the user message `prisma.message.create` to include agentType: `data: { projectId, agentType, role: 'user', content: userMessageContent }`
Update the assistant message `prisma.message.create` (inside onFinish) to include agentType: `data: { projectId, agentType, role: 'model', content: event.text }`
Do NOT change: model, tools, system prompt, rolling window logic, streaming headers, or error handling
userStories.notes: Read src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts first. Make minimal changes — only add agentType to the 4 locations specified. The route must keep export const runtime = 'nodejs'. Existing Trend Mapper behavior is unchanged because the default is 'trend-mapper'.
